title: WPCRL/953/2026 of RAJ KUMAR Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
WPCRL No. 953 of 2026
Hon'ble Alok Mahra, J.
Ms. Prabha Naithani and Mr. R.P. Singh,
learned counsel for the petitioners.
2. Mr. Sanjeev Singh, learned counsel for
the intervener.
3. Mr. Deepak Bisht, learned D.A.G. for the
State.
4. Mr. Manoj Kumar, learned Standing
Counsel for the Union of India.
5. Mr. Saurabh Kumar Pandey, learned
counsel for the complainants/respondents.
6. Learned State Counsel has supplied the
instruction/report before this Court today. The
same is taken on record.
7. Pursuant to the order dated 27.05.2026
and 04.06.2026, a meeting was held in the
office of the Director, Higher Education on
01.06.2026 between Director and
representatives of the complainant,
representatives of Management of the
Institute and other aggrieved persons.
8. After perusing the contents and audio
and documentary evidence, which was given
by the complainants, the Director, Higher
Education, have recommended that it would
be appropriate that the whole investigation be
done by the S.I.T., who have expertise in
dealing with all such cases.
9. Heard learned counsel for the parties
and perused the record.
10. Learned counsel for the petitioners

would submit that though the respondents
have given an undertaking that they have
deleted the messages and videos, which they
have uploaded against the petitioners and his
family members in the social media, but, they
are still in circulation.
11. State is hereby directed to look into it
and shall ensure that all the derogatory
comments, which are there in the social
media against the petitioners and his family
members be deleted immediately.
12. As has been recommended by the
Director, Higher Education, Senior
Superintendant of Police concerned is hereby
directed to constitute a S.I.T. and look into
the complaint in relation to the allegations
raised by the complainant, who were earlier
engaged in the teaching job in Swami
Vivekanand College of Education, Matlabpur,
Roorkee. S.I.T. should invite complaints from
all the aggrieved persons. The whole inquiry
should be conducted within a period of six
months from the date of constitution of the
S.I.T.
13. With the above observation, the present
writ petition stands disposed of accordingly.
14. Pending applications, if any, shall also
stand disposed of accordingly.
 (Alok Mahra J.) 10.06.2026
Ujjwal
